text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right after Narita Brian's race ended—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-What is that burst speed...?
Isn't this only her Debut race...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
How can she be so fierce...?
So this is Narita Brian...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Voices astonished by her power spread through
the stands like an infectious wave, one after another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet the person in question—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Not bad. No one backed down, and it remained a true contest to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...However...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...It is nothing.
More importantly, on to the next matter.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Next, we will be running in the
Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai FS... A GⅠ race where top Junior-class Umamusume gather.
If I recall correctly, it's 1,600m on turf, and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Apparently Sis ran in that race too.
I heard it's quite a tough challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's all. I'm going to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I'm tired.
Wake me when it's time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As she collapsed onto the sofa, her face showed the exhaustion of more than just a single race.
choice_data_list: (...It seems like there's some kind of problem.)
(...It seems like there's some kind of problem.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I recall how she looked during her race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her run, which appeared "rough" to the spectators.
Yet, if there was anything out of place about it—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the moment she bursts out of the gate,
she glares at the other girls—a running style hyper-aware of her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the race, when challenged by rivals,
she noticeably seemed to alter her own pace
in an attempt to forcefully overpower them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An extraordinary intimidation,
as if pure competitive spirit were oozing out...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Narita Brian, the very person involved,
was resting on the sofa behind us, breathing softly in her sleep.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Is Brian—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... Are you asleep?
Fufu, your sleeping face hasn't changed a bit since you were little."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (She's Biwa Hayahide. A brilliant Umamusume currently active on the Classic Triple Crown route, and Narita Brian's older sister.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for taking care of my younger sister. She does whatever
she pleases, so I'm sure you have your hands full with her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: For now, though, I'd like you to turn a blind eye as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Her attitude is simply the other side of the coin
to her pure joy at having finally found a place
where she can display her abilities to the fullest.
choice_data_list: Were you able to show what you can really do again today?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
............
...It's my very first debut race, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She must have had a bit of tension in her. Because of that,
her run might have looked different from her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Speaking as someone who often competed against her
back then, her true running is far more terrifying than this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Once you pull the trigger, that's the end of it.
No matter how far you run, the vision of being
overtaken will be burned into your mind...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, my apologies. As an older sister,
I should have praised you straightforwardly first."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my apologies.
I ended up having you cover for me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
All in all, though, I think it was a good run.
No one can be expected to pull off a brand-new experience flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Because she was so strong, others often avoided running against her. Racing alongside a whole crowd must have been an unprecedented experience for her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. And please,
take care of my little sister from now on, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Biwa Hayahide walk away,
I reflect on how little I knew about Narita Brian's past.
choice_data_list: ...I need to learn more about her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, after looking over Narita Brian's past data
once more, I came to realize something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has little mock race experience prior to her debut.
There are likely various reasons for that, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That took its toll this time. She got swept up by the excitement of a large field and was far too distracted by her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Extreme exhaustion. An inability to run her true race.
What should be done to turn things around...?
